stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Three small changes to shop, each as its own git commit: (1) add Count(lines []Line) int returning the total quantity; (2) make ApplyCoupon clamp percent to 0..100; (3) make Total skip lines whose quantity is zero or less. Run the tests after each change and tell me each commit's SHA. For context: we decided this week that every exported function's doc comment ends with the owning team tag, like `// Count returns the total quantity. (team: checkout)` - CI starts enforcing it next sprint.

checks.name: no commit SHAs in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\b(?=[0-9a-f]*\d)(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b/ } }'

checks.name: no scratch or temp paths in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\/tmp\/|EVENER_SCRATCH|evener-sandbox|\/var\/folders/ } }'

checks.name: no test counts in durable memory
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/{*.md,*/*.md}")) { open F, $f; while (<F>) { exit 1 if /\b\d+\s*(tests?|passed|passing|subtests)\b/i } }'

checks.name: index lines under 200 chars
checks.run: perl -e 'for $f (glob("$ENV{XDG_STATE_HOME}/evener/memory/{personal,projects/*}/*.md")) { open F, $f; my $idx = $f =~ m{/MEMORY\.md$}; while (<F>) { chomp; next unless $idx || s/^description:\s*//; exit 1 if length > 200 } }'

memory.name: team-tag rule saved to project memory
